name: Task board (kanban)
summary: Status columns of task cards with priority, due date and assignee; a per-card actions menu (Popover + Menu) moves and deletes tasks without drag and drop.
description: Kanban-style board for tasks, tickets or pipeline stages. Each card shows the essentials as text; moving a task is a menu action so the board works by keyboard. Includes the menu-button composition (PopoverTrigger + Menu) for row and card actions anywhere in an app.
whenToUse: Items move through a few ordered statuses and users scan by status.
whenNotToUse: Many items needing sorting/filtering by several fields: use list-page (offer both as a Board/List toggle).

composition.role: Board: grid, 1 column on phones, md:grid-cols-2, 2xl:grid-cols-4

children.role: Actions menu button (aria-label names the task)

layout: Columns stack on phones, pair from md and go four-up only from 2xl: next to a w-64 NavPanel, xl leaves ~230px per column, too narrow for card metadata.
Popover is not portaled: never put a menu trigger inside an overflow-x/overflow-y container (a horizontally scrolling board, a scroll area) or the menu is clipped.
A card shows title, project, priority Badge, due date, assignee; details open in detail-page or form-dialog.
Menu button: Nucleux has no MenuButton component. PopoverTrigger renders the <button>: give it IconButton-like classes and an aria-label, and control Popover open so picking an item closes it.
Show an empty column as a dashed placeholder, not nothing.
responsive: 1 column below md, 2 from md, 4 from 2xl (grid items-start so short columns don't stretch).
Avoid a horizontally scrolling board: it clips the card menus (see Layout).
accessibility: Each column is a section labelled by its heading; card titles are h3.
Moving and deleting are menu items, so no drag and drop is required (add drag as an enhancement only).
Menu has role=menu/menuitem; the trigger's aria-label says whose actions it opens.
states: Loading: three Skeleton cards per column. Empty board: ErrorState variant=empty with a create action.
antiPatterns: Drag and drop as the only way to change status.
Nesting an IconButton inside PopoverTrigger (button inside button).
Status shown only by card color.
